full_judgment: 2. The opposite parties as plaintiffs instituted Other Class Suit No. 553 of 1976 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge Rajshahi impleading the petitioners and opposite parties No. 28-42 as defendants praying for partition of the suit land. The plaintiffs case is that the suit land originally belonged to one Abdul Gani Salter who transferred the same before the C. S. operation in favour of one Bashiruddin and in the C. S. Khatian the name of Bashiruddin was rightly recorded.
